purpose: Prospective WELP methodology and historical compatibility policy; snapshot manifests remain immutable.
rules: Frozen historical snapshots, contracts, fixtures, scorers, and campaign bundles are immutable. Reproducing a historical campaign uses the frozen artifacts recorded in that snapshot.

New campaigns run under the current DRAFT snapshot. The 2026-09-19 methodology revision introduces outcome semantics (welp-outcomes 0.1.0-draft), the generation-budget policy (welp-generation-budget 0.1.0-draft), reliability scorer v2 + gate_v2 (welp-reliability 0.2.0-draft), and in-repo classification (welp-final-classification 0.2.0-draft).

Historical campaign results are never relabeled under the new outcome vocabulary. Scorer-only rescoring of retained raw outputs is new supplementary evidence, explicitly linked to the original event; it never rewrites result JSON, reports, or published verdicts.
A supplemental completion (e.g. a bounded retest under the revised methodology) is a NEW event linked to the original campaign/evidence, following the append-only precedent.

Validator R09-R14 apply from 2026-09-19, R15-R16 from 2026-09-23, and evidence-bound hardening from 2026-09-24. An older fixture/scorer hash differing from current source is compared with its frozen snapshot manifest, including 2026-09-23 snapshots, never invalidated merely because current source advanced. Current evidence must match current pinned bytes.

No cross-methodology score equivalence is claimed between v1 boolean outcomes, 2026-09-19 CP-1 triples, and prospective calibrated semantic/deployment prompt lanes. Each comparison must retain prompt/profile/budget/fixture identities.

2026-09-23 supersedes word-fraction Family A construction with final-rendered-token placement; retains the five facts, depths and ±0.50 pp threshold. Earlier 8K/16K placement failures are fixture-limited historical evidence, not model retrieval failures. New lane-specific context reserves supersede a universal 512-token semantic reserve; 512 remains historical or a real declared operational cap.

Prompt lanes MINIMAL, DEPLOYMENT, PUBLISHER when material, OPTIMIZED when preregistered are prospective. Historical prompts cannot be retroactively attributed to a new lane without exact byte/config evidence. Classification profile identity is required prospectively; blocked methodology execution does not imply an integration-blocked model.

Append-only 2026-09-23 profile clarification: a selected deployment profile ID fixes artifact/quant/runtime/build/hardware/context/template/DEPLOYMENT prompt/sampler/effective reasoning, but not generation-budget lane. Semantic and operational lanes are distinct measurements of the same selected deployment profile. Classification 0.3.1 and validator require selected profile equal DEPLOYMENT prompt profile; the prior 0.3.0 wording stays frozen under its own snapshot.

Blocked LFM2.5-8B-A1B evidence and its BOS-invalidated attempt remain untouched: C0/artifact/runtime identity and measured fit/performance may be cited if unchanged and verified; reliability under arbitrary historical ceilings and context Family A 1.1 scores are not equivalent to prospective lanes/placement. Repeat reliability semantic/operational lanes and useful-context rungs under the new frozen method in a NEW linked campaign; recheck admission/profile, do not promote 2048 diagnostic outputs or reasoning traces to a verdict.

2026-09-24 changes safety adjudication, reliability sampling sensitivity, evidence-bound classification, canonical context answer scoring/coverage, setup qualification, real-work oracles and measurement compatibility. No cross-version score equivalence is claimed. Unresolved review or invalid/missing required evidence blocks COMPLETE_PASS, not model safety.

Retained LFM prospective retest-2 interpretations need qualification: task FAIL did not establish unsafe behavior; campaign-local context scoring rejected correct 8K answers; hidden tool-discovery information and unexecuted Linux coverage limit role conclusions. Original raw data, scores and verdicts remain unchanged. Development replay is not a new classification, campaign event or LocalMaxxing result; any public erratum must be append-only and explicitly authorized.

2026-09-24 context-outcome repair (Granite D-01, welp-context 0.3.0-draft): an execution-valid answerless budget-exhausted Controlled Context cell is a measured BUDGET_LIMITED row with the CP-1 triple semantic NOT_EVALUABLE / completion FAIL_LENGTH / budget EXHAUSTED_IN_REASONING under a declared/effective-ON reasoning surface; it covers required-cell coverage and never validates capability. Existing 0.2.0-draft context rows keep their frozen dispositions and outcome triples and are never relabeled; the retained Granite COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS predecessor stays unchanged, and its linked successor re-derives the affected cell from original raw bytes under the repaired vocabulary.

Unchanged: exact artifact/hardware/runtime provenance, CP-1 outcome axes, evidence classes, early host-safety stops, execution state distinct from verdict, append-only evidence, public central registry authority and clean-success automatic lifecycle closeout.

2026-09-25 reasoning profiles (welp-reasoning-topology-0.1.0-draft; validator R18-R21 from snapshot date 2026-09-25): every prospective campaign first qualifies the model's ACTUAL reasoning topology experimentally on the pinned runtime (case A no reasoning mode / B reasoning cannot be disabled / C effective supported ON-OFF control / D additional bounded effort levels). Case C requires linked sibling Reasoning On AND Reasoning Off profile events, each a complete WELP campaign with independent setup, calibration, ceilings, behavioral evidence and derived classification; profile verdicts are never averaged, merged or scored into a model-level value. Requested-but-ineffective OFF controls never create a Reasoning Off profile. Only explicitly marked profile-invariant records (artifact/runtime/hardware/fit identity) may be shared across sibling events; behavioral evidence is profile-specific and cross-profile binding fails closed. Additional effort levels are qualified prospectively and become full profiles only when genuinely supported, measurably distinct and deployment-relevant; no unbounded sweep and no post-hoc best-mode search. Historical single-profile campaigns (including the original Ling-3.0-tiny event) remain valid unchanged under their frozen snapshots and never need invented Reasoning Off results.
